triggered_by: pre-experiment audit before next task selection
summary: Codebase is structurally sound post-reorg; primary issues are oversized functions (9 functions >80 lines, 1 god function at 152 lines), a stale experiment ID in README, and a docs file (experiment-context.md) that needs a naming pass. No dead modules, no circular imports, no dead test files.

findings.title: God function: run_multiturn_ab.main() at 152 lines
findings.evidence: main() is 152 lines — 3x the 50-line max. Handles arg parsing, .env loading, git setup, investigation loop, scoring, and JSON output in a single function.
findings.fix_suggestion: Split into: _parse_args(), _setup_runner(), _run_investigations(commits, harness, ...), _write_output(results, path). Each phase <30 lines.

findings.title: report_builder.build_report() at 89 lines — orchestrates 5 distinct concerns
findings.evidence: Single function handles localization, evidence tagging, risk evaluation, archetype detection, and report assembly.

findings.title: historical_rag.get_historical_defect_context() at 89 lines — already a known TD
findings.evidence: Handles CSV loading guard, KNN ranking, fallback computation, and block assembly in one function. Covered by td-h3a-unit-tests task.
findings.fix_suggestion: Tracked as td-h3a-unit-tests + td-h3a-cache-refactor in state.json. Split: _get_knn_matches(), _get_project_fallback(), _format_defect_context_block().

findings.title: orchestrator.investigate() at 87 lines — multi-turn loop with inline scoring
findings.evidence: Turn loop, tool dispatch, follow-up decision, and result assembly are all inlined.

findings.title: context_builder.build() at 86 lines — context assembly god method
findings.evidence: Handles diff assembly, file history, author stats, expansion sections, budget tracking, and truncation metadata in one method.

findings.title: smart_diff.assemble_diff() at 81 lines — file ranking + budget logic mixed
findings.evidence: Ranking, truncation, budget tracking, header generation inlined.

findings.title: run_eval.setup() at 83 lines — eval runner setup god method
findings.evidence: Handles CSV loading, repo probing, stratification, provider selection, and JiraClient in one method.

findings.title: risk_policy: two functions over 60 lines (evaluate_risk=70, evaluate_risk_from_hypotheses=64)
findings.evidence: evaluate_risk() and evaluate_risk_from_hypotheses() each exceed 50-line limit.
findings.fix_suggestion: Extract guard checks and cap logic into named helpers: _apply_archetype_cap(), _compute_supported_score(). Functions drop to ~30 lines each.

findings.title: README.md first line still says 'Experiment #19b'
findings.evidence: README.md:3 — '> **Experiment #19b** — a long-running investigative agent...' — product description should use capability language.
findings.fix_suggestion: Replace with: '> **Commit Risk Investigator** — a long-running investigative agent that examines real code commits...' (or similar capability name). Remove experiment ID from public-facing description.

findings.title: docs/experiment-context.md uses 'Experiment #19b', 'iter-1', 'feat-2', 'feat-3' throughout
findings.evidence: Entire framing document uses experiment codes. The concepts (investigative agent vs classifier, oracle isolation, six dimensions) are still valid — the naming is stale.
findings.fix_suggestion: Replace experiment-code references with capability names matching the naming_map in state.json. Alternatively archive to .harness/.archive/docs/ since the concepts are captured in architecture.md.

findings.title: docs/datasets.md references 'feat-2 coverage report' and 'feat-3' clones
findings.evidence: datasets.md mentions 'feat-2 coverage report' and 'V1 clones (feat-3)' — setup context is valid but experiment IDs should be removed.
findings.fix_suggestion: Replace 'feat-2 coverage report' → 'chain coverage report'; 'V1 clones (feat-3)' → 'local git clones'.

findings.title: scripts/run-iter-1-eval.sh has stale 'iter-1' name and docstring
findings.evidence: File named 'run-iter-1-eval.sh' with docstring '# iter-1 validation'. Script logic itself is current (runs run_eval with --max-evals 5).
findings.fix_suggestion: Rename to run-smoke-eval.sh; update docstring to '# Smoke eval: n=5 stratified gate'.

findings.title: src/eval/ is a separate top-level package alongside src/commit_investigator/
findings.evidence: src/eval/ contains only forensics.py (595 lines). It's a standalone analysis tool used only by run_eval.py. The boundary is intentional (eval-only code) but could live in src/commit_investigator/runners/ or src/commit_investigator/infra/.
findings.fix_suggestion: Consider moving forensics.py → src/commit_investigator/runners/forensics.py or keeping as-is if the eval/app separation is intentional. Low urgency.

findings.title: __pycache__ in src/commit_investigator/ root — 29 stale .pyc from pre-reorg flat layout
findings.evidence: Pre-reorg: all modules were flat (archetype.py, orchestrator.py, etc.). Post-reorg: moved to subpackages. Stale .pyc files remain in root package cache. Gitignored — no git impact.
findings.fix_suggestion: Run 'find src/commit_investigator/__pycache__ -name "*.pyc" -delete' to clear. No code change needed. Does not affect tests.
